title: 第13章 驮马第14章 艾莎夫人的魅力
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：“这么多？”
叶海听到这个数字后都惊了一下，他知道这个时期军队后勤补给是最困难的事情，但也没想到这么难啊。
叶海也并不是完全没有指挥过军队出征，只不过之前基本都是些清理商路的小任务，目标都是些强盗之类的小角色。
每次出动的人也不多，最多也就是百来人。
所以即使叶海身为麾下有着数万军队的伯爵，也没有切实体验过率大军出征的后勤补给压力。
艾莎夫人幽幽的说道：“伯爵大人，您是骑士，应该知道一匹马每天要消耗多少饲料和干草吧。”
“当然，一般情况下一匹马一天要喂四到五公斤左右的饲料和六七公斤左右的干草，然后还得给它准备个盐砖让它舔，不然那马容易没力气。”
叶海身为一名骑士，平常虽然不需要亲自饲养战马，但怎么说这些年也是与战马朝夕相处，对他们的习性还是有着一点了解的。
“没错，正如你说的，一匹马一天至少要消耗十二公斤的物资。”
艾莎夫人在桌上摊开一张计算布，上面画满了各种线条与格子，然后又取出了金银铜三种货币摆在桌上当筹码进行计算。
这是明斯克大陆上流行的一种计算手段，计算时可以通过摆放筹码快速进行加减乘除运算。
小时候叶海也学过，不过后来转头就把这玩意儿忘到脑后了，因为多数情况下，这东西还没他在心算快。
毕竟他怎么说上辈子也是接受过高等教育的人。
“即使按照单人单马计算，光是骑士团加上第一军团的千人骑兵队以及一些传令哨兵，就差不多有一千两百匹马。”
“而这么多匹马，每天就需要消耗十四吨以上的物料。”
艾莎夫人的计算速度很快，显然她对于这种被称为筹码计算桌的计算方法运用的相当熟练。
“再加上我们之前算过的人员食物开销，每天十三吨，这合计每天需要消耗的食物和饲料就得二十七吨以上。”
“一匹驮马大概能驮500公斤左右的物料，每天二十七吨就意味着每天需要消耗五十四匹驮马所承载的物资。”
“还有个问题我们显然也不能忘记，那就是驮马自己也得吃饲料，虽然消耗比战马略少一点，但一天饲料和干草加起来十公斤也是要的。”
“驮马的数量增加了，负责赶马的人自然也得增加，就算一个赶马人同时能看住两匹驮马，平均下来每增加一匹驮马也得再加半公斤粮食的开销。”
“从灰鸦堡运输到第戎得一百三十公里，以我们辎重队的行军速度，至少得需要四天。”
“也就是说，一匹驮马到第戎之后，还没卸粮自己就已经消耗了五十公斤粮草，然后还得留下返程的粮草，这又得五十公斤粮草。”
“最终运抵第戎的粮草大概就剩下四百公斤左右。”
“而大军每天需要消耗二十七吨粮草，这就意味着每天需要消耗68匹驮马运送来的物资。”
“出于安全保证考量，首批随同大军一起出发的物资至少需要保证三十天所需，那就至少需要两千匹驮马。”
艾莎夫人放下了手中筹码，结束运算，抬头看向叶海。
有人这时候就要问了，这不是才两千匹吗？
刚才明明说是三万匹啊，还差了两万八千匹去哪了。
叶海盯着计算桌上的筹码皱起了眉头：“我们不可能单人单马，骑士团的人每个人都有四匹马，军团骑兵队的人也都是一人双马。”
content_en:
: "So many?"
Ye Hai was shocked when he heard this number. He knew that the logistics supply of the army was the most difficult thing during this period, but he did not expect it to be so difficult.
It's not that Ye Hai has never commanded an army on an expedition, but it was just a small task of cleaning up trade routes, and the targets were small characters such as bandits.
There are not many people dispatched each time, only a hundred people at most.
Therefore, even though Ye Hai, as an earl with tens of thousands of troops under his command, had never experienced the logistical supply pressure of leading an army on an expedition.
Mrs. Elsa said quietly: "My lord, as a knight, you should know how much feed and hay a horse consumes every day."
"Of course, usually a horse needs to be fed about four to five kilograms of feed and about six or seven kilograms of hay a day, and then you have to prepare a salt brick for it to lick, otherwise the horse will easily lose strength."
As a knight, Ye Hai usually does not need to raise war horses personally, but after all, he has been living with war horses day and night over the years, and he still has a little understanding of their habits.
"Yes, as you said, a horse consumes at least twelve kilograms of supplies a day."
Mrs. Aisha spread out a calculation cloth on the table, which was filled with various lines and grids. Then she took out three currencies of gold, silver and copper and placed them on the table as chips for calculation.
This is a popular calculation method on the mainland of Minsk. When calculating, you can quickly perform addition, subtraction, multiplication and division operations by placing chips.
Ye Hai also learned it when he was a child, but later he turned around and forgot about this thing, because in most cases, this thing is not as fast as his mental arithmetic.
After all, he said he had received higher education in his previous life.
"Even if calculated based on one person and one horse, the knights plus the thousand-man cavalry team of the First Legion and some messenger sentries alone have almost 1,200 horses."
"And with so many horses, more than fourteen tons of materials are consumed every day."
Mrs. Elsa's calculation speed is very fast, and she is obviously very skilled in using this calculation method called the chip counting table.
"Coupled with the personnel food expenses we calculated before, which is 13 tons per day, the total food and feed consumption required per day is more than 27 tons."
"A pack horse can probably carry about 500 kilograms of materials. Twenty-seven tons per day means that the materials carried by fifty-four pack horses need to be consumed every day."
"There is another issue that we obviously cannot forget, that is, the pack horse also needs to eat feed. Although the consumption is slightly less than that of the war horse, it still costs ten kilograms of feed and hay a day."
"As the number of pack horses increases, the number of people responsible for driving the horses will naturally increase. Even if one horse driver can watch two pack horses at the same time, on average, each additional pack horse will cost an additional half kilogram of grain."
"The transportation from Gray Crow Castle to Dijon is one hundred and thirty kilometers. At the marching speed of our baggage team, it will take at least four days."
"In other words, after a pack horse arrives in Dijon, it has already consumed fifty kilograms of grain before unloading it, and then has to leave behind the grain for the return journey, which requires another fifty kilograms of grain."
"There are only about 400 kilograms of grain left in the final shipment to Dijon."
"And the army needs to consume twenty-seven tons of grain and grass every day, which means that it needs to consume the supplies delivered by 68 pack horses every day."
"For safety reasons, the first batch of supplies to accompany the army must be guaranteed for at least thirty days, which requires at least two thousand pack horses."
Mrs. Aisha put down the chips in her hand, finished the calculation, and looked up at Ye Hai.
Someone will ask at this time, isn't this only two thousand horses?
It was clearly stated just now that it was 30,000 horses, but where was the shortfall of 28,000 horses?
Ye Hai stared at the chips on the calculation table and frowned: "We can't have one person and one horse. Everyone in the Knights has four horses, and everyone in the Legion Cavalry also has one person and two horses."
title_en: Chapter 13 The Pack Horse Chapter 14 The Charm of Lady Elsa
